name: Embr — Live Streams
subtitle: Stream Player, 7TV & BTTV Chat
privacyPolicyText: Embr has no advertising and no tracking, and keeps no analytics about what you watch or say. Your settings, watch history and block list stay on your device, and your favourites sync only through your own iCloud. Embr keeps an anonymous Midgar ID and sends Midgar's server the records of tips and of the Founding Supporter purchase. If a Founding Supporter signs in with Twitch, their Twitch user id, founding number, badge colour and name style are stored and shown to everyone using Embr. Chat reports and blocks you send reach the developer without your Midgar ID or Twitch token. Signing in with Twitch is optional and happens on Twitch; Embr never sees your password. Full policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/legal/embr/privacy
